title: KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans Held by One Customer
content:
A customer may hold KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans on several vehicles; there is no limit per customer. The limit that applies is a limit per vehicle, under the rule that a vehicle may carry only one active plan.

## Basis questions

**Is there a maximum number of plans one customer may hold?**
No. The number of KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans a customer may hold has no maximum; the count of plans a customer already holds does not by itself prevent the sale of another plan.

**Where does a limit apply, then?**
On the vehicle. Each plan covers one vehicle, identified by its VIN, and the only limit on holding plans is the one set for each vehicle: one active plan per vehicle.

**Does it matter whether the plans are at the same level?**
No. The rule sets no limit per customer at any level, so a customer may hold, for example, plans at different levels on different vehicles, or plans at the same level on different vehicles.

## Hypothetical holdings

The holdings below are example situations, not customer records.

| Example holding | Limit per customer reached? | Governing limit |
|---|---|---|
| One active KestrelCare Maintenance Starter plan on one vehicle | No | Per vehicle |
| Active plans on three different vehicles | No | Per vehicle, for each of the three |
| Active plans on five different vehicles, buying a plan for a sixth | No | Per vehicle, for the sixth |
